# @suluk/shadcn

> v4 'Suluk' Schema Objects -> shadcn/ui form + table specs and TSX scaffolds (react-hook-form + zodResolver). Codegen, no runtime UI deps. CANDIDATE tooling.

> Reference tooling for the OpenAPI v4.0 Suluk candidate.

### API

- `formSpec`: Build a FormSpec from an object Schema Object.
- `tableSpec`: Build a TableSpec.
- `renderFormTsx`: Render a shadcn <Form> component from a FormSpec. Returns TSX source as a string.
- `renderTableTsx`: Render a shadcn <Table> component from a TableSpec. Returns TSX source as a string.
- `renderDetailTsx`: Render a read-only shadcn detail (show) view from a FormSpec. Returns TSX source as a string.
- `renderFormSkeletonTsx`: A form skeleton — one label+control placeholder per field, plus a submit-button placeholder.
- `renderTableSkeletonTsx`: A table skeleton — a header row of column placeholders + N body rows of cell placeholders.
- `renderDetailSkeletonTsx`: A detail skeleton — one label+value placeholder row per field.
- `renderShadcnTheme`: The full shadcn theme file set from a TokenSpec/ThemeSpec: the css path → globals.css + components.json.
- `renderGlobalsCss`: The shadcn `globals.
- `renderComponentsJson`: The shadcn `components.json` CLI config — `cssVariables: true`, so the generated tokens drive the components.

## Optional

### Types

- `FieldWidget`: The shadcn form control we pick for a property. Drives which control the renderer emits.
- `FieldSpec`: One form control, derived from a single object property.
- `FormSpec`: `@suluk/shadcn` — the UI corner.
- `ColumnSpec`: One table column, derived from a single object property.
- `TableSpec`: `@suluk/shadcn` — the UI corner.
